label: Glass & materials
description: One glass material for every Bifrost surface. 'All surfaces' sets the look everywhere; each surface can override any property, or follow All surfaces completely with 'Link all surfaces'. Empty = inherit (from All surfaces, or from the theme's approved standard glass).

instances.label: All surfaces
instances.description: The base for every surface below

instances.label: Top bar
instances.description: The bar, its menus and the frame

instances.label: Popup menus
instances.description: Dropdowns, dock and tray menus, tooltips

instances.label: Launcher
instances.description: The launcher and the power menu

instances.label: Notifications
instances.description: Notification popups, the notification center and system prompts

instances.label: Settings groups
instances.description: Glass containers inside Settings. Background blur is shared by the Settings window.

settings.label: Transparency
settings.description: 0 % = solid, 100 % = clear glass. Empty = the standard glass

settings.label: Background blur
settings.description: Blurs what is behind the surface (done by the compositor). 0 = off. The compositor has one blur strength for everything it blurs: the strongest surface with blur on sets it

settings.label: Tint
settings.description: Colour of the glass. Empty = the theme's graphite

settings.label: Glass thickness
settings.description: Depth, density, bevelled edge and inner light. 1 = standard, 4 = very thick

settings.label: Grain
settings.description: Fine noise in the glass. Empty = the standard glass

settings.label: Refraction
settings.description: Light bending along the bevelled edge, with a faint colour split. Simulated: the compositor doesn't let a panel read what is behind it

settings.label: Prism glow
settings.description: Aurora-coloured glow along the rim. 0 = off

settings.label: Border
settings.description: Shows an outline around Bifrost's glass surfaces, such as panels, the dock and menus. All surfaces applies to linked surfaces. Application window borders are configured under Windows & compositor.

settings.label: Border thickness
settings.description: Thickness of the outline around the glass

settings.label: Border opacity
settings.description: How visible the outline is. 0 = transparent, 100 = fully opaque

settings.label: Border colour
settings.description: Colour of the outline. Empty = the theme's silver

settings.label: Corner radius
settings.description: Empty = the theme's radius for the surface

settings.label: Shadow
settings.description: 0 = no shadow, 1 = standard, 3 = deep. All surfaces also controls Hyprland window shadows when Bifrost manages window appearance. Shadows drawn by apps are unaffected.

settings.label: Link all surfaces
settings.description: All surfaces sets every property for every surface. Each surface keeps its own values; they come back when this is turned off

settings.label: Unlinked surfaces
settings.description: Surfaces that use their own values although Link all surfaces is on. Editing a linked surface adds it; its Linked switch removes it again
